quality.format_valid_warning: Includes exact substring constraint; not a pure formatting measure.

bootstrap.method: Within each fixed article resample families with replacement; include all member questions; paired EM count difference divided by resampled row count. Equal-tail percentile interval via sorted indices floor((B-1)*0.025) and floor((B-1)*0.975).
bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional on four selected articles. Not a population-wide guarantee.

primary_confirmation_gate.vs_q4: Selected paired EM gain has 95% cluster-bootstrap lower bound > 0
primary_confirmation_gate.vs_control: Selected paired EM gain has 95% cluster-bootstrap lower bound > 0

stop_rule: One evaluation per fixed variant; no reselection, retraining, prompt/scorer changes or sample replacement after observing outputs. Quality failure does not fail reproducible research artifact release; it blocks claiming confirmed benefit.
performance_scope: No new speed claims on this cohort. Prior matched eight-prompt performance experiment remains a separate frozen workload.
dataset_boundary: New to known project datasets; public SQuAD dev, not an official hidden test. Possible pretraining contamination; article domain shift relative to old dev.
